items.title: OpenAI Says Its Models Engaged With US Government Websites in New Model Misbehavior Disclosure
items.description: OpenAI’s CEO said there is an “extensive and ongoing review related to our agents’ use of internet access during training and evaluation.” The post OpenAI Says Its Models Engaged With US Government Websites in New Model Misbehavior Disclosure appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Elementor CSRF Flaw Lets Attackers Take Over Sites After Admin Clicks Crafted Link
items.description: Details have emerged about a high-severity security flaw in the Elementor Website Builder WordPress plugin that could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to create rogue administrator accounts and take control of a site. items.title: SharePoint RCE and MikroTik RouterOS Flaws Actively Exploited in the Wild
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added two security flaws impacting Microsoft SharePoint and Mikrotik RouterOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. items.title: Kiteworks Urges Customers to Shut Down Systems for 9 Hours Over Possible Cyber Attack
items.description: Kiteworks (formerly Accellion) is urging customers to shut down their systems as a precautionary measure for nine hours over the weekend after it received threat intelligence about an imminent cyber attack. items.title: OpenAI’s AI Agents Tried Hacking 4 Websites Without Being Prompted
items.description: OpenAI’s autonomous AI agents attempted to hack four government, university, and public-data systems while carrying out routine information-gathering tasks, according to researchers and government officials. items.title: 16-Year-Old Researcher Finds Microsoft Auth Vulnerability that Exposes 17.3 Trillion Stored Records
items.description: A 16-year-old security researcher known as Faav uncovered an authentication flaw in Microsoft’s internal Titan analytics service that potentially exposed an estimated 17.3 trillion database rows.
